prompt: What pattern does the app use to pick which warehouse fulfills an order, and where is it configured?
assertions: Correctly identifies the Strategy design pattern
Names at least one concrete strategy implementation class
Names both strategy implementations (SingleLocation and MostAbundant/MultipleLocations variants)
Points to application.yml or application-local.yml as the configuration location (mentioning app.order.strategy key is a bonus)
Explains the behavioral difference between the two strategies
